# Copilot Instructions

You are building a children's math practice web application.

Requirements:

- React 19
- TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS
- Functional components only
- Reusable components
- No any types
- Strong TypeScript typing
- No duplicated code
- Mobile-first responsive design
- LocalStorage persistence
- No backend
- No mock APIs
- Keep files under 300 lines where practical.
- Use React hooks.
- Follow clean architecture.
- Use accessibility best practices.
